user_story:
As a user, I want to fill out the contact form on the contact page so that I can send feedback to the website team. After submitting the form, I expect to see a confirmation message or be directed to a success page.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. The contact form must contain the following fields: 
   - Name: <input name='name' class='form-control' placeholder='Name'>
   - Email: <input name='email' class='form-control' placeholder='Email'>
   - Subject: <input name='subject' class='form-control' placeholder='Subject'>
   - Message: <textarea id='message' class='form-control' placeholder='Your Message Here'></textarea>
   - Submit button: <input name='submit' class='btn btn-primary pull-left submit_form' value='Submit'>
2. Upon successful submission, the user should be redirected to a success page or see a confirmation message.
